why: The Machado matrices have negative coefficients and rows that exceed 1 on saturated input, so the product must be clamped to [0, 1] before encoding. Unclamped, protan takes pure green to a red channel above 255, which overflows into bit 24, and deutan takes pure red to a negative blue channel, which corrupts the packed colour. Only the clamp test's saturated primaries catch it: #d64545, the colour the per-type pins use, stays inside the gamut under all three.
killedBy: colour-vision simulation (Machado 2009, severity 1) clamps a channel the matrix pushes outside [0, 1]
